traits.division_pattern.note: APweb Arecales page (read 2026-10-16): palm leaves plicate, pinnately pseudocompound, palmate or costapalmate in some subfamilies (mainly Coryphoideae). 'Usually pinnate' is our species weighting (most palm genera are feather palms).

traits.perianth.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): palm perianth varies among subfamilies but is generally three sepals and three petals (Arecaceae states sepals_and_petals); DELTA Dasypogonaceae (read 2026-10-16): six tepals. Monocot default tepals is wrong by species weight (about 2,450 palms vs 16 Dasypogonaceae).
